Subject: Stakeholder ladder + security scope intake — LedgerPay next steps

Hi Sophie / Mark —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and security: 

1) Buyer / decision path (what we heard)
   - Economic buyer: Mark Ellis (Head of Payments) — final pricing decision
   - Procurement & legal: procurement@ledgerpay.com (procurement intake + contract review)
   - Security reviewer(s): Sophie Turner + internal InfoSec (please confirm names / emails)

2) Scope for security questionnaire (what we need clarified)
   - Systems in scope: public API endpoints used by LedgerPay production, SSO/auth flow, customer data storage (S3), and any batch jobs that call Redwood inference.
   - Environments: production only to start; test/staging if you want optional review later.

3) Documents / artifacts we typically collect now
   - Completed security questionnaire (we can send Redwood template)
   - Network diagram showing how traffic flows to Redwood (public/private subnets)
   - Data classification for the fields sent to inference (PII / PCI / tokenized)

4) Proposed next steps (timeline)
   - Today/Tomorrow: Sophie to share security contact list + attach questionnaire/network diagram.
   - By Thu 9/10: Redwood (me + Laura) will send a filled security questionnaire and follow-up questions.
   - Week of 9/14: 30-min technical intake with LedgerPay InfoSec and our infra engineer to walk the diagram and narrow scope.

If this matches your view, I’ll attach the questionnaire and a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) we can track in HubSpot. Also looping Laura (renewals/procurement lead) to map contractual steps.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0197
